Jia is a kaliri found at Falcon Watch in Hellfire Peninsula.

__NOTOC__ Jennalla Deemspring was a high elven ranger. She was stationed with a small group of high elven survivors near the ruined Lordaeron palace gardens when the death knight Arthas returned to Lordaeron, took back control of the kingdom, and ordered the Scourge to exterminate all remaining survivors. Arthas, along with Kel'Thuzad and Sylvanas Windrunner, may have come upon Jennalla and made quick work of her and her brethren.
Jimmy the Stable Boy is a human located at Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.

Jezebel Bican is an Inscription supplies vendor at Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula. She stands right next to Michael Schwan, Master Inscription Trainer. They are in the tower on the same floor as the master enchanting trainer directly across the platform.
Jenkins is a title obtained from the achievement Leeeeeeeeeeeeeroy...? : Jenkins See Leeroy Jenkins for more information.
Jennifer Owings is a Forsaken Food Vendor located at New Agamand in Howling Fjord.
Jessica Evans is a level 70 Forsaken reagent vendor located at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord

The Jeweled Fishing Pole has a rare chance to be found within a Bag of Shiny Things, rewarded from capital fishing dailies and Bag of Fishing Treasures (Dalaran), which are rewarded from the fishing dailies Marcia Chase give in Dalaran.

Jennings is a leper gnome found at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight. He is the assistant of Doctor Malefious. He seems to just walk around the caged "Lucid Test Subject" and will occasionally say "LUNCH!" and jump into the air, and sometimes kills a roach.

Jenus Killian was a mage who, when using the spell Blink, accidentally got three mithril support rods inserted in the head. The Royal Apothecary Society supplied a corrosive brew that helped resolve the situation, but with a result of permanent hair loss of the affected area. His/her accident is chronicled in the book Blinking Rules & Regulations.
Jessica Morris is a Forsaken located in the docked ship at Vengeance Landing along with her family Julian, Nicole, and Jason Morris.
Jimmy Hyal died in the fire of Shady Rest Inn. He appears when the player put a wreath on the Hyal Family Monument during the quest Peace at Last.
Jessicalu was a Blizzard Technical Support employee and Blizzard Poster on the official [http://us.battle.net/wow/en/forum/1011701/ WoW Technical Support forum].
Jin'Zil's Voodoo Stick is provided for Jin'Zil's Blessing.
Jeweler's Sapphire Monocle is created with Jewelcrafting (455); taught by Design: Jeweler's Sapphire Monocle.

Jeztor's War Rider is a level 60 elite wyvern found in Alterac Valley. If successfully summoned by its master, Wing Commander Jeztor, it hovers outside Dun Baldar and bombards members of the Alliance from above. The summoning quest is Call of Air - Jeztor's Fleet.

Jevan Grimtotem is a tauren shaman of the Grimtotem tribe. He is known to all as Stormsong because of his affinity with the air and water. Ever since Magatha Grimtotem's betrayal and exile from the Horde, Jevan has remained loyal to the Horde and leads the Grimtotem who remain in Thunder Bluff.
__NOTOC__ Jessup McCree is a dwarf quest giver found near Frostmane Hold in Dun Morogh. He is a renowned demolitionist that was hired along with his crew by .

Jibidiah "No Fingers" Gragglefutz is the inventor of the goblin trike. Gragglefutz had been a street-side grenade salesman for decades, and years of product-related mishaps had borne fruit in this speedy, durable, and mostly unexplodable vehicle. Jibidiah gained some renown for his creation, and he now claims that Gallywix has him hard at work on a speedier "turbo" version of the trike. Jibidiah's one complaint is that the substantial cash reward for designing the trike has been stuck in a particularly insidious mess of red tape and mail delivery issues. The trade prince apologizes for this and promises to put his top goblins on it immediately.
Jeweler's Amber Monocle is created with Jewelcrafting (460); taught by Design: Jeweler's Amber Monocle.
Jeweler's Ruby Monocle is created with Jewelcrafting (450); taught by Design: Jeweler's Ruby Monocle.
Jeweler's Setting is sold by jewelcrafting supply vendors for .
Jeralee is a gnome mentioned by Morris Vant, the blacksmith of Hearthglen. She once bought an axe twice her size from him.

Jimb "Candles" McHannigan claims to have once been William Pestle's number-one supplier of candles, stealing them from kobolds before he was injured. He now limps and is unable to perform his job or even use the toilet unassisted, instead residing on Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm in Westfall. According to Jimb, he is the originator of the line "I TAKE CANDLE!" which he coined in response to the kobolds' constant cries of "You no take candle!" He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Jin'do the Godbreaker is the final boss of the reopened heroic version of Zul'Gurub.
Jimmy Lo is senior concept artist (or "Concept Wizard") for World of Warcraft, primarily illustrating scenery such as dungeons and towns (concept art). He has also made artwork for a few TCG cards.
Jheremy Raapack is the penciller of the upcoming graphic novel.

Jillian Grell was a Forsaken merchant who lived in Brill. When she had to think things over she often traveled to the farm, where she had once lived. It was at one of these times the blood elven apprentice jewelcrafter Rinn Firecaster arrived at her farm to bring her a gem she had ordered for her uncle Barnabas Grell. The blood elf had not been there long though, when the Scarlet Crusade led by Captain Renee Lauer arrived at the farm and executed them both. Her death set a series of events in motion, resulting in the deaths of her uncle and Rinn's sister, and the raising of Renee Lauer as one of the undead.

Jensen was member Creedy's gang of bountyhunters. Durring a hunt for three frostsaber cubs, he made Creed miss his shot at the cubs' defenders, Teleena and Hemet Nesingwary, and therefore Creed shot him.
Jennette Doyle is a worgen reagent vendor located at the Talonbranch Glade in Felwood. She can be found within a caravan.
__NOTOC__ Jeweled Scarabs are scarabs found in Halls of Origination.

Ji Firepaw is a pandaren and a follower of the more direct Huojin philosophy, is adamant that inaction is the greatest injustice. He holds that it's honorable to defend home and family no matter the cost. Outgoing, passionate, and not one for deep thought, he is always the first into the fray. Ji finds himself attracted to the practicality that defines the Horde. Although it will cost him dearly, he will decide to carry the Horde banner when he leaves the Wandering Isle. After the Wandering Isle, Ji can be found as a monk trainer outside the Ring of Valor in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Jessica Straus is a voice actress who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Jinanya the Clawblade is a virmen located in Sunsoaked Meadow in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Jian Ironpaw is a pandaren master of the Way of the Oven, a style of Pandaren cooking. She can be found at the Halfhill Market in Valley of the Four Winds. She often sets out Fresh Bread on the table in front of Gina Mudclaw.

Jensen Thomasson is a Forsaken warlock trainer found in the Pools of Vision of Thunder Bluff. He is performing some unknown ritual with Morairania Horton and Delano Morisett. Strangely, nobody of them has even a little bit of mana.
Jian is a pig located at the Grassy Cline in the Valley of the Four Winds. Upon being rescued, it is seen at Thunderfoot Ranch, accompanied by Ning and Ting.
Jiang Ziya is a pandaren fishing vendor located at the Anglers Wharf in the Krasarang Wilds.
Ji-Lu the Lucky is a pandaren located at the Lucky Traveller in Kun-Lai Summit.

Jiao Spawn are merciless ones that appear at Soggy's Gamble in the Dread Wastes. These offspring of Jiao are initially fished out of the water during Reeltime Strategy, but after Jiao itself appears off the coast, they begin swarming Soggy's Gamble en masse. They disappear after Jiao's defeat during The Mariner's Revenge. Master Angler Ju Lien has strung up a group of them on his fishing rack. __NOTOC__

Jiao is an enormous kraken that appears just off Soggy's Gamble in the Dread Wastes during Reeltime Strategy and The Mariner's Revenge. Accompanied by its numerous spawn and a large flock of Mistfeather Gulls, Jiao first appears to kidnap Master Angler Ju Lien, and adventurers must work with Captain "Soggy" Su-Dao on the Mist-Hopper Jr. to drive it off the coast with harpoons. __NOTOC__

Jim Cummings is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions. He is a world-renowned voice actor best known for his work in animated TV shows, films and video games.
Jeremy Soule is a composer who wrote some of the themes and music for World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria.
Jin'ya, Orb of the Waterspeaker drops from Lei Shi in Terrace of Endless Spring.

Jerry Carter can be found in the Caverns of Time instance, Escape from Durnholde Keep. He and Jonathan Revah are commemorating a new tower built between Tarren Mill and Southshore. It's unknown what became of him.
__NOTOC__ Jim-Jim is a hozen found in the Skyrange in the Valley of the Four Winds.

__NOTOC__ Jewel Danio have a high chance to be caught from Jewel Danio Schools, which can be found on the Timeless Isle. They also have a common chance to be caught when fishing in open water on the isle with high enough fishing skill. Prior to Patch 5.4 and Garrosh Hellscream's destruction of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, they were found exclusively in that zone. When almost all of the lakes and rivers were drained in the shockwave of Garrosh throwing the Heart of Y'Shaarj into the waters in front of Mogu'shan Palace, Cloud Serpents were able to save them from extinction by transporting them in little buckets to the Timeless Isle. A board game known as jihui is one of the most prominent games found throughout Pandaria, mostly among the pandaren, but others such as Wrathion, Vol'jin, and Tyrathan Khort have begun learning the game as well. The game was designed in order for both players to win, or more specifically for both players to arrive at a satisfactory conclusion. Wrathion kept one jihui board for himself.
Jin Ironfist is a pandaren located in the Crypt of Forgotten Kings scenario.
Jeremy Seely was a Blizzard employee and Technical Writer for World of Warcraft. He has an NPC that was added in Patch 6.1: Jeremiah Seely. He has since left the company.
Jia Ji is a pandaren who acted as a courier during the trial of Garrosh Hellscream.

Jerry Chu is a Blizzard employee, and currently the Global Licensing Manager, Publishing and Multimedia for Blizzard Entertainment. He also did the licensing for the Ultimate Visual Guide, along with Matthew Beecher and Audrey Vicenzi.
Jeremy Cranford is a Blizzard employee and the Art Director for Blizzard Entertainment. He also provided Art Direction for the Ultimate Visual Guide.
Jialing is a pandaren child found in the Timeless Isle during the Celestial Tournament along with Yaya and Xiaohu sitting by a bowl of Noodles.
Jenova Longeye is a pandaren located at the Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

Jimmy Truong is a pandaren located under a bridge at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest. He is performing a stance to Dan Mei, Kevin Horng, and Emily Mei.
Jiasska the Sporegorger is a hydra found on the southernmost point of on the beach below Pinchwhistle Point in the Spires of Arak. Around the hydra, seveal dead Infected Bruisers litter the area.

__NOTOC__ Jhorn the Mad is an ogre located in the in . He, along with Thoktar Ironskull and Vul'gor, can be found overlooking the Arena Floor. He is also later seen overlooking the Coliseum in Highmaul.

Jeron Emberfall is the Horde Tower Guardian in Ashran, found atop the Emberfall Tower itself. He stands watch over both the Emberfall Tower zone and Volrath's Advance, summoning dazzling phoenixes to explode upon the heads of any attackers who should attempt to invade the bases below. He later participated to the battle for Seething Shore from the Horde gunship. Speaking with him provides refreshments.

being taken care of by Jin'Tiki.]] .]] Jin'Tiki is a Zandalari troll located in Shoaljai Tar Pits in Nazmir. Jin'Tiki is a criminal that was exiled to Vol'dun. Jim Lee (born August 11, 1964) is a Korean-American comic book artist, creator and publisher. After graduating from Princeton, he decided to attempt illustrating comic books, and met with success. Lee's distinctive, crisply hatched line art style and rigid, idealized anatomical forms established a new stylistic standard for superhero comic-book illustration and reinforced a popular trend away from brushed to penned inking in the late 20th and early 21st century. Lee is currently one of the most successful artists in American comics. Joe, Mike, and Scott were stomped to death by Slave Master in Strahnbrad as Arthas watched helplessly.

This is a list of voice emote jokes for each race and each gender. Because of the way player characters work, these lines are accessed via the /silly slash command. These jokes are partially a descendant of "repeated click" responses from the real time strategy (RTS) games, wherein you could repeatedly click on a unit and it would begin saying strange things after a few clicks. You can still get "irritation responses" from NPCs in World of Warcraft by repeatedly clicking on them. Unlike any other class in the game, demon hunters have entirely new voice acting unique to their class. This includes the /silly emotes, which will also be listed in its own section. ;See also: *FrameXML/GlobalStrin
Jitters is a human quest giver located at Raven Hill in Duskwood.
__NOTOC__ Jocaste is a night elf hunter trainer located in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was caught in the chaos and could be saved.

Jorad Mace was a former paladin in the service of Prince Arthas, before Arthas' betrayal of the Alliance. His failure to stop Prince Arthas' betrayal has led him to lose his connection to the Light. He became a mercenary for hire in Tarren Mill where his adventures with Anveena, Kalecgos, and Tyrygosa eventually led him to reconnect with the Light and become the heroic knight he was meant to be.

Jinky Twizzlefixxit is a gnome quest giver located at the Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles. Jinky participated in the MEGA's Speedbarge boat race along with her teammates, Tony Two-Tusk and Rugfizzle. She acted as the engineer of Freebooters' Fire.
Johan Focht is a Forsaken artisan mining trainer located in the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
Jinxed Hoodoo Piles appear in various locations throughout Zul'Gurub.

Jonathan Carevin is a human quest giver located in Darkshire in Duskwood. As his quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy of the region, his family and several supporters combat the undead in Duskwood and are willing to take the fight to them rather than simply protect the populace as the Night Watch does. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Jonathan was seen cowering in fear in his house when the Veiled Hand controlled the town.

Jorb is an ogre that patrols the path between the Crossroads and Ratchet, accompanying the goblin weapon vendor Lizzarik. Should he be provoked into battle, he will attack with his fists. One note is that the reputation he is tied with is Gadgetzan, while his companion Lizzarik is tied with Ratchet, although killing him will result in a loss of Ratchet reputation and not Gadgetzan.
Jon-Jon the Crow is a ghoul found in the Ruins of Jubuwal in Stranglethorn Vale. Jon-Jon owes a debt to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley even in undeath.

__NOTOC__ Jol is a draenei paladin trainer located in the Vindicators' Sanctum in the Vault of Lights of the Exodar. She wears a partial Soulforge Armor set, minus the helm and gloves. She previously sent young vindicators into a quest to gain the Redemption spell. Following the death of Tirion Fordring, Jol joined the Silver Hand and is located in the Sanctum of Light.
Joraal is a draenei stable master located at Telredor in Zangarmarsh.
Joonho's Mercy dropped from the rare spawn General Fangferror in Azshara.
Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment is a quest reward from Bailor's Ore Shipment.
Jordan's Ore Shipment is looted from Bailor's Ore in Loch Modan.
Jordan's Weapon Notes is provided for The Test of Righteousness (2).
Jormungar (sometimes called jormungar wyrms) are enormous worms native to Northrend. They have muscular, flattened bodies with rows of crystalline spines along either flank.
Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass dropped from Jon-Jon the Crow in Stranglethorn Vale.
Jlarborn the Strategist is a vrykul gladiator in the Ring of Judgement in the Howling Fjord. He needs to be slain during Stunning Defeat at the Ring.
Jordan's Hammer is located in Shadowfang Keep of Silverpine Forest. It is found in the stables in the first courtyard.
Jordan's Smithing Hammer was given to Jordan Stilwell by his father.
Jinky Wingnut is a gnome located at Fizzcrank Airstrip in the Borean Tundra.
Jormungar Tunnelers are jormungar located in the northern Dragon Wastes in the Dragonblight.
Jir'see stand beside its mistress Angela “The Claw” Kestrel on top of the tower in Thrallmar.
Jo'mah is a jungle troll inscription trainer found in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

__NOTOC__ Jormungar Scales are scales skinned from the jormungar in Northrend. They can be combined with skinning from Jormungar Scale Fragment. They can also be crafted with Northrend Leatherworking (1); taught by trainers.
Jormungar Leg Reinforcements is a leatherworking-only permanent enchant to legs that increase Stamina by 55 and Agility by 22.

Jortas was a small village somewhere on Azeroth. Centuries ago, at the very start of Aegwynn's tenure as Guardian of Tirisfal, the minor demon Zmodlor appeared and started a cult called the Burning Blade. Zmodlor's cultists took over the schoolhouse of Jortas, planning to sacrifice its children using a sword covered in oil and set alight as a ritual tool. Aegwynn appeared just in time to save the children and neutralize Zmodlor, with the event being her first ever demon banishment, but it made the Council of Tirisfal angry at her methods.
Jonathan Lewis is a forsaken grand master mining trainer at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.
Jonah Sterling's Spyglass drops from Hozzer at Garvan's Reef in the Howling Fjord.

Jormungar Behemoth is an elite jormungar found in Ulduar. Although not technically a part of a boss fight, killing the Jormungar Behemoth and the surrounding adds will trigger the start of the event that leads to the boss fight with Thorim. Players attempting to defeat the Jormungar Behemoth should face it away from the raid.
Jormscale Footpads are crafted with Northrend Leatherworking (50); Taught by trainers.
Jormungar Meat can be found in northern Dragonblight, after blowing up a Hulking Jormungar with .
Jormungar Egg Sacs drop from Deep Jormungar in the Foot Steppes of Storm Peaks. They are summoned by using the Earthshaker Drum near Mysterious Snow Mounds.
Jizzle Grikbot is a goblin pit engineer located at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles. He cannot be found in the World of Warcraft.
Joboba Mezbreaker is a gnome located under the Violet Citadel in the Underbelly. She can provide directions for various locations in the Underbelly.
Jorcuttar is a jormungar spawnmother found in Hibernal Cavern in the Storm Peaks.
Jormungar Control Orbs are used by Earthen Jormungar Handlers to train Jormungar into Tamed Jormungar. They are located at the Western part of Snowdrift Plains in The Storm Peaks.

Jorum Balnir was the head of the Balnir family of horse-breeders, the husband of Vara, and father of Jarim. In his youth, Prince Arthas Menethil often sneaked off to the Balnir Farmstead to admire Jorum's horses and play with Jarim. Neither of the boys cared that a horsebreeder's son wasn't a proper companion for a prince, and their parents didn't try to stop the friendship. During one such winter play session, Jorum invited the boys to assist the horse Brightmane as she gave birth to her son Invincible, who later became Arthas' own steed. During the winter storm that led to the death of Invincible, it was Jorum and his son who found Arthas and rescued the prince from freezing to death in th
Jintha'kalar Passage, appropriately named, is a large passage that connects the ruins of Jintha'kalar in Dragonblight to Zul'Drak.
Joint-Severing Quickblade is a quest reward from The Cleansing Of Jintha'kalar.
Johaan's Findings are provided by Apothecary Johaan for Delivery to Silverpine Forest to be delivered to Apothecary Renferrel.
Johan is a mule located in Westfall Brigade Encampment in Grizzly Hills.

Jornun is a jungle troll of the Darkspear tribe located in Darkspear Hold on the Echo Isles. He hands out raptor rides to young troll adventurers, like Zuni, who wish to follow Vol'jin's call to engage in battle against the naga.

Johnny Awesome is a blood elf hunter who has a spirit beast frostsaber called Dazzle for a pet. He used to ride a celestial steed named Twinkles, and now rides Invincible's Reins which he has named Spooky.
__NOTOC__ John is a human child located in the second floor of the northernmost house of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

Jocas Irongear was a goblin engineer, who left Theramore aboard his zeppelin with his companions the night elf warden, Blackhawk, and the tauren spiritwalker, Ashar Ghosthoof. A mysterious merchant hired them to transport a cargo of spices out of Ratchet. Blackhawk discovered the crates contained smuggled carrion beetles. The merchant sensing he was caught, removed his hood and revealed his true identity of a troll witch doctor. He then attacked the crew, but was slain by the warden. The zeppelin was damaged during the fight, and Jocas attempted to fix it before it crashed.
Jona Ironstock is dwarf quest giver located in Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. She is good friends with Grelin Whitebeard.
__NOTOC__ Jorlan Trueblade is a human quest giver found within Darkbreak Cove of Abyssal Depths.

__NOTOC__ Johnathan Staats is a worgen quest giver located at Lor'danel, in the Alliance-aligned territory of Darkshore. He gives the quests formerly given by Gubber Blump, who went missing after the destruction of Auberdine.
Joeyray is a goblin cooking vendor who has a shop in Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.
Jordan Olafson is a human quest giver located at the Firelands Forgeworks in Mount Hyjal.
Joanna Blueheart is a human quest giver found in the new Alliance settlement of Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows. She leads the Alliance troops in the fight to take Stonard.
